normative.title: CSS Syntax Module Level 3 — consume a number

input.source: ECMAScript string interpreted as UTF-16 code units
input.precondition: current input starts with a CSS number representation

success.language: optional sign; digits plus optional fraction or leading-dot digits; optional complete exponent
success.offset: advance by exactly the consumed representation; incomplete decimal/exponent and repeated-fraction suffixes remain unconsumed
success.value: Number(consumed representation), preserving signed zero, underflow, and infinities

result.descriptors: all three are data properties, enumerable, writable, configurable
result.type: integer iff neither decimal point nor exponent was consumed; otherwise number

failure.transaction: source identity/content, offset, and predecessor value identity are unchanged; isError is true; no throw
failure.ahead_diagnostics: pre-existing diagnostics whose furthest offset is ahead of this attempt remain structurally unchanged

ordinary_diagnostics.contract: candidate-local parse-that expected labels are internal and structurally validated but deliberately not normalized here
ordinary_diagnostics.credit: no ParseIssue fidelity credit; typed/public parents own stable user-facing issue translation

composition.parent_failure_state: parse-that parent value/offset-on-error is outside this leaf contract; this row scores parent accept/reject and source preservation only

source_preservation: consumed spelling is recoverable from unchanged source plus start/end UTF-16 offsets; this row emits no serializer
work_limits: no candidate throw on public hostile cases; no manual source/cursor loop, slicing scanner, token tape, CST, filesystem, process, network, or corpus read

oracles.live: later parent/public differential only; not an internal consume-number authority
oracles.browser: later typed-parent witness; CSSOM does not expose this internal triple
oracles.bbnf: module/ownership coordination only, not semantic truth
